summary: BIER is a multicast forwarding architecture that needs no explicit tree-building protocol and keeps no per-tree state in transit routers. This RFC defines BGP extensions to carry the BIER-specific information that routers need to share, using BGP when it is the routing protocol in use.

eli5.summary: Instead of drawing a delivery map for each group, packets list who must get a copy. This lets routers share the info they need for that using BGP.

questions: how to advertise bier info in bgp
